articles.title: Giants promote top outfield prospect Bo Davidson, who will make MLB debut Monday
articles.description: Top San Francisco Giants outfield prospect Bo Davidson was called up and will start in right field Monday night at Oracle Park.

articles.title: What we learned as leadoff Drew Gilbert ignites Giants' offense in win vs. Twins
articles.description: Drew Gilbert's breakout second half continued and Bo Davidson's MLB debut brought buzz to Oracle Park in the San Francisco Giants' win Monday night.

articles.title: Bo Davidson's huge first inning in MLB debut shows what Giants prospect made of
articles.description: Bo Davidson's unique blend of power and speed was on display in the San Francisco Giants outfielder's MLB debut on Monday night at Oracle Park.

articles.title: Blade Tidwell leaves start early in Giants' game vs. Twins with apparent injury
articles.description: Giants right-hander Blade Tidwell left San Francisco's game against the Minnesota Twins in the fourth inning on Monday at Oracle Park.

articles.title: A day in the booth with legendary Giants broadcasters Mike Krukow, Duane Kuiper
articles.description: Alex Pavlovic spent a day in the booth with legendary San Francisco Giants broadcasters Mike Krukow and Duane Kuiper.

articles.title: Matt Wilkinson shines in Giants' final away game despite 3-1 loss to Dodgers
articles.description: Despite getting swept in their final road series of the season, Matt Wilkinson delivered his best start yet for the San Francisco Giants.

articles.title: Giants place Logan Webb on IL with blister injury, ending his 2026 MLB season
articles.description: The San Francisco Giants placed starter Logan Webb on the 10-day injured list with a right middle finger blister on Friday, which will end his season.

articles.title: What we learned as Giants' pitching allows five home runs in loss to Dodgers
articles.description: Alex Pavlovic delivers three takeaways from the San Francisco Giants' 8-2 loss against the Los Angeles Dodgers on Friday night at Dodger Stadium.

articles.title: Giants secure first road series win in three months with victory vs. Cardinals
articles.description: Led by Anthony Molina, the San Francisco Giants secured their first road series win in three months with a victory over the St. Louis Cardinals.

articles.title: Giants legend Duane Kuiper reveals throat cancer diagnosis, undergoing treatment
articles.description: Longtime Giants broadcaster Duane Kuiper announced that he is being treated for a new form of cancer, but will call games during the final homestand.

articles.title: Giants share Rafael Devers recovery timeline after star's core-muscle surgery
articles.description: San Francisco Giants slugger Rafael Devers should be able to complete most of his rehab from core-muscle surgery before MLB's looming labor battle.

articles.title: Victor Bericoto's big night not enough as Giants' bullpen falters vs. Dodgers
articles.description: Victor Bericoto announced his return from the injured list, but the San Francisco Giants' bullpen had another rough night in a loss to the Dodgers.
